description: This is a shell script file that contains test cases for testing rename detection functionality in a version control system (likely Git). The script sets up test environments, manipulates files, and verifies the output of diff operations to ensure proper rename and copy detection.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success with a given description. Runs the subsequent shell commands and checks for expected results.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw_z
methods.description: Compares the actual diff output with an expected output for diff-raw -z results.
